# archestra_oauth_client (Data Source)

Finds an OAuth client by its exact name. Its secret is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "archestra_oauth_client" "ci" {
  name = "CI pipeline"
}

output "ci_client_id" {
  value = data.archestra_oauth_client.ci.client_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the OAuth client.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Public OAuth client ID.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the client is disabled.
- `grant_type` (String) OAuth grant the client uses.
- `id` (String) OAuth Client ID.
- `service_account_id` (String) Service account the client signs in as, when it has one.
